title: Zodiacs Engine (@zodiacs/engine)
description: TypeScript astrology calculations for browsers and Node.js: tropical planetary positions, natal charts with houses and aspects, transits, synastry, secondary progressions, Moon phase and Saturn returns; local birth times resolved on the tz database's history, and instants read as UTC, UT1 or TT; Hellenistic timing techniques; and the sidereal zodiac with Jyotish techniques. The repository also holds a conformance suite for astrology computation (test vectors, each decided by an independent arbiter with a stated tolerance, and a harness that runs any engine against them) and a historical time atlas of what civil clocks showed, where and when, with a primary source for every rule. Licences: the code is MIT; the ΔT table values the package ships are CC BY 4.0, so the package as distributed is MIT AND CC-BY-4.0 (LICENSING.md); the conformance suite is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0; the atlas's data and documentation are CC BY 4.0 and its tools MIT (atlas/LICENSING.md).
